baseline.method: EER operating threshold; nearest 10% of development scores form declared abstention margin

candidate.method: EER operating threshold; nearest 10% of development scores form declared abstention margin

training.method: Frozen official AASIST-L 160-dimensional embedding + 88 LFCC statistics; trained PyTorch 248-64-1 MLP. Encoder weights unchanged.
training.pretrained_on: ASVspoof2019 LA training set according to official repository; no world-first or universal unseen-generator claim
training.augmentation: One clean and one hash-selected phone/noise condition per training source; never applied to development labels or test training

model.score_kind: Uncalibrated logit score; higher means more synthetic evidence
model.localization: Causal 4.0375-second windowed baseline; 500 ms updates are not 500 ms localization accuracy

note: AASIST uses first 64600 samples, repeating shorter inputs. The adaptation also uses LFCC statistics from the supplied clip/window. Timeline uses past-only windows. Repetition adds no new speech evidence. Acoustic authenticity does not establish caller identity or scam intent.
